title: Data 360: Activation Topology for Unified Individuals

steps.prompt: Nightly identity jobs run, but marketing campaigns are still delivering duplicate messages to the same person under different CRM and web IDs. Which architecture topology ensures activations deliver unified individuals without duplicate channel contacts?

options.label: Unified Individual Segment Activation
options.rationale: Activations built on segments of the Unified Individual data model object guarantee that deduplicated enterprise identities govern channel reach, eliminating source-key duplicates.

options.label: Direct Source DMO Activation
options.rationale: Directly activating from source Contact DMOs completely bypasses the Identity Resolution engine and Unified Individual profiles, causing channel activations to treat CRM and web records as separate individuals.

options.label: Raw Data Lake Ingest Push
options.rationale: Skipping both data model harmonization and identity resolution delivers raw, unharmonized lake records directly to marketing channels, compounding fragmentation and schema errors.
